title: Leave Me Alone
description: When you are AFK and take damage or a creeper appears nearby, you will be kicked
body:
The mod tracks your mouse activity. If you stop moving your mouse for a set amount of time, you are marked as AFK. While AFK, the mod watches out for you - if you take damage or a creeper appears nearby, you will be automatically kicked from the server or world.

Features
- Detects AFK based on mouse inactivity
- Kicks you if you take damage while AFK
- Kicks you if a creeper appears within 10 blocks while AFK
- Configurable AFK timeout via config/leave-me-alone.json
- Client-side only - no server installation required
